partner_result_applied.scope: exact same-constant reduction from arbitrary admissible product densities to compact finite-union indicator inputs

proved_results: For fixed symmetric A, the best pure-quadratic small-ball constant equals the best constant for affine terms b in Range(A), uniformly in constants c.
Finite interval fragments admit an exact convex component-box mixture with matrices D_k A D_k, weights product_i ell_i summing to one, and range-compatible translation linear terms.
The original three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis need not survive an individual tiny-fragment congruence D_k A D_k; fragmentwise reapplication of the target is invalid.

If a physical 2x2 principal block A_JJ has determinant Delta>0, then every admissible product law satisfies ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= pi/sqrt(Delta), uniformly in outside couplings, translations, supports and global sign pattern.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-WEIGHTED-CONGRUENCE/HYBRID-v1: control the exact weighted affine-box mixture from the original three-large-eigenvalue geometry when no physical definite pair has a dimension-free determinant lower bound, or construct a valid counterexample.
